Jasmine / Ben — below are concise technical points we can drop into the questionnaire and the one-pager. Happy to provide JSON examples (see attachment) and a short SCIM delta example if they want it inline.

SSO (SAML & OIDC)
- SAML 2.0 supported, both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. We consume IdP metadata XML; we provide SP metadata at /saml/metadata. ACS URL: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs (per-tenant endpoints available). EntityID is tenant-scoped; we can provide a static SP EntityID or issue tenant-specific values.
- OIDC (RFC 8414) supported: discovery at /.well-known/openid-configuration, supports Authorization Code + PKCE, token introspection, revocation. We support IdP token validation and optional userinfo checks.

SCIM provisioning
- SCIM 2.0 (RFC 7644) supported: full CRUD (POST/GET/PATCH/PUT/DELETE), group membership management. We support PATCH (add/replace/remove) and bulk operations.
- Delta / incremental syncs: we expose lastModified-based queries and support the standard "filter" and "startIndex" parameters. For high-volume customers we also support a pulldelta endpoint that returns changed records since a provided timestamp to limit scan costs.
- Rate limits: default is 10 req/s/org for SCIM endpoints on Hosted; Dedicated/Private can be configured (we've recommended 20-50 req/s for enterprise provisioning windows).
- Authentication: bearer token (recommended) for Hosted. For Private deployments we support mutual TLS (client cert) and IP allowlists.
- Example payload: see attached scim_provisioning_example.json (user create + group assignment).

RBAC & admin controls
- Role model: Organization Admin, Team Admin, Developer (limited write), Viewer (read-only). Custom roles supported via API.
- Delegated admin: map IdP groups (SCIM groups or SAML assertions) to Redwood roles; delegation can be scoped to group/team level.
- Admin actions via Console + REST API (audit logged).

Audit & retention
- Audit log of auth events, admin changes, provisioning actions: default retention 13 months (configurable up to customer-specific SLAs for Dedicated/Private). Logs are exportable (JSON/NDJSON) and streamable to S3/Customer SIEM.

Encryption & compliance
- Data-in-transit: TLS 1.2+ with forward secrecy.
- Data-at-rest: AES-256. Keys managed via KMS; Private customers may use their own KMS/HSM.
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II audited; we can provide the bridge letter and evidence under NDA.

If Aurora wants, I can prepare a 1-page technical appendix with the specific ACS/metadata values and a 50-line SCIM delta example.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Michael — attached is our completed questionnaire and a short technical appendix summarizing key items you called out. Summary highlights below (concise):

- SSO: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP/SP metadata exchange, IdP- and SP-initiated flows) and OIDC with discovery + PKCE. Per-tenant ACS/EntityID values available; we'll provide SP metadata URL for your IdP team.
- Provisioning (SCIM): SCIM 2.0 supported with PATCH and bulk operations; delta/pulldelta options available for efficient incremental syncs. Hosted uses bearer tokens; Dedicated/Private can use mutual TLS + IP allowlist. Default SCIM rate limit on Hosted is 10 req/s/org; this is configurable for Dedicated/Private. Example payloads included.
- RBAC/Admin: Built-in roles (Org Admin, Team Admin, Developer, Viewer) + custom roles via API. Group-to-role mapping supported (SCIM group -> Redwood role). Delegated admin scope can be restricted to specific teams/projects.
- Audit & logs: Auth events, provisioning actions, and admin changes are audited. Default retention 13 months; logs can be exported to S3 or pushed to your SIEM.
- Compliance: TLS 1.2+, AES-256 at rest, KMS integration; SOC 2 Type II evidence available under NDA.
